endpoint.description: WebSocket endpoint URL, from the 'url' field in the API response.

channelName.description: WebSocket header 'channelName', from the 'channelName' field in the API response.

Authorization.description: WebSocket header 'Authorization', use your service app token.

token.description: WebSocket header 'token', from the 'token' field in the API response.

closedCaptionResponse.description: Closed caption message received from the WebSocket.

pingResponse.description: Ping message received from the WebSocket.
